title: Rate Limit Policy Compiler
description: Compiles rate limiting configuration for API endpoints. Enforces: all public endpoints have rate limits, auth endpoints have stricter limits than regular endpoints, both burst and sustained rates are defined.

error_codes.RL001: rate-limit-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: endpoints[], defaultLimits{burst, sustained}
error_codes.RL002: Public endpoint has no rate limit — all public endpoints must have explicit request limits
error_codes.RL003: Auth endpoints (login, token, password reset) do not have stricter limits than general endpoints
error_codes.RL004: Rate limit definition missing burst or sustained rate — both must be defined per endpoint or globally
error_codes.RL006: 429 responses do not declare Retry-After header — clients need Retry-After to implement correct backoff; set retry_after_header: true
